name: git
description: /git:commit, /git:mr, /git:review, /git:ci, /git:ci-cd, /git:daily, /git:release, /git:main, /git:sync, /git:split and /git:undo. The plugin uses the forge MCP (GitHub or GitLab) when it exists, and the CLI when it does not. Hooks validate the message, the branch and the push. For a PR/MR (CLI or MCP), hooks validate the title, the description, the squash option and any AI mention.
